connections.title: Connections
connections.subtitle: Connect your brand's social channels and websites. Publish and schedule content directly from Contivo.

noWorkspace.title: Create a workspace first
noWorkspace.body: Connections belong to a workspace — it decides which brand's content gets published. Create one under Workspaces, then come back.

modal.title: Connect a Social Account

platforms.linkedinDescription: Publish text posts and articles to your <bdi>LinkedIn</bdi> profile or company page.
platforms.xDescription: Post tweets and threads to your <bdi>X</bdi> account.
platforms.facebookDescription: Publish posts and link shares to a <bdi>Facebook</bdi> Page you manage.
platforms.tiktokDescription: Publish photo carousel posts and videos to your <bdi>TikTok</bdi> account.

modal.unavailableTitle: {platform} has no API credentials on this deployment.
modal.unavailableDescription: Not set up on this deployment — no API credentials yet.
modal.instagramNote: Coming in Phase 2 — requires media pipeline.
modal.securityNote: Your access token is encrypted and stored securely. It is never exposed to the frontend. You can revoke access at any time.

accounts.title: Connected Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Manage your linked social media accounts.
accounts.emptyBody: Connect <bdi>LinkedIn</bdi>, <bdi>X</bdi>, or <bdi>Facebook</bdi> to start publishing directly from <bdi>Contivo</bdi>.
accounts.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect this account? Published content will remain on the platform.

rules.title: Publish Rules
rules.subtitle: Default behaviors applied to every publishing action in this workspace.
rules.hashtagsDescription: Automatically append relevant hashtags based on content topic.
rules.formatterDescription: Adjust formatting and character limits per platform before publishing.
rules.crossPostingDescription: Automatically post to multiple platforms at once. Available in Phase 2.
rules.note: Settings are saved per workspace. Individual post settings override these defaults.

queue.title: Publish Queue
queue.subtitle: Scheduled and in-progress posts. Published and cancelled jobs appear in History.
queue.emptyBody: When you schedule content to publish, it will appear here.

history.title: Publish History
history.subtitle: All completed publish attempts — published, failed, or cancelled.
history.emptyBody: Published and failed posts will appear here.

sites.noWorkspaceBody: Create a workspace first — a site connection serves the content of one workspace.
sites.title: Websites
sites.subtitle: Give a site an API key and it can pull its published posts from <bdi>Contivo</bdi>. Works with any stack — the site fetches, <bdi>Contivo</bdi> never pushes into your codebase.
sites.fieldRevalidateUrlHint: Called after each publish so your site can clear its cache.
sites.fieldRevalidateSecretHint: Sent as a Bearer token to that URL.
sites.secretPlaceholder: a random string your site checks
sites.emptyBody: Add a site to give it an API key. Autopilot can then write for the blog channel and your site will serve the posts.
sites.actionRotate: Issue a new key (invalidates the current one)
sites.keyBody: Copy it now — this is the only time it is shown. <bdi>Contivo</bdi> stores only a hash, so it cannot be shown again. Lost it? Rotate to issue a new one.
sites.keyStore: Store the key as CONTIVO_API_KEY on your site — server-side only.
